description: This file implements the 'git merge-base' command, handling various options to find common ancestors, octopus merge bases, and branch points in a Git repository.

methods.name: int show_merge_base(struct commit ** rev,size_t rev_nr,int show_all)
methods.description: Displays merge bases for given commits, optionally all or the first only based on show_all flag.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(const char * arg)
methods.description: Resolves a given string to a commit object, erroring if invalid.

methods.name: int handle_independent(int count,const char ** args)
methods.description: Handles the '--independent' option, listing commits not reachable from others.

methods.name: int handle_octopus(int count,const char ** args,int show_all)
methods.description: Handles the '--octopus' option, computing merge bases for multiple commits.

methods.name: int handle_is_ancestor(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Handles the '--is-ancestor' option, checks if one commit is ancestor of another.

methods.name: int handle_fork_point(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Handles the '--fork-point' option, finds the fork point of a commit from a ref.

methods.name: int cmd_merge_base(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git merge-base' command, parsing options and delegating to handlers.

ctags.name: cmd_merge_base
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: handle_octopus
ctags.pattern: /^static int handle_octopus(int count, const char **args, int show_all)$/

ctags.name: show_merge_base
ctags.pattern: /^static int show_merge_base(struct commit **rev, size_t rev_nr, int show_all)$/
